Board Certification: Look for attorneys certified in Personal Injury Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization.
Contingency Fee: Most reputable injury lawyers charge nothing upfront and only take a percentage if they win or settle your case.
Track Record: Ask about their specific experience with wrecks similar to yours (e.g., commercial truck collisions, drunk driving crashes, or uninsured motorist claims).
